about_item: Dog Sofa Bed & Strong Support - The L-shaped corner sofa designed dog bed is equipped with 2 fluff-filled bolster railings, providing extra support to our dog's neck and head, promotes optimum comfort and security. The 3-inch thick high-density egg crate foam helps evenly distribute our dog's weight, effectively relieves joint pain and arthritis, encourages restful sleep.

Ultra-soft & Waterproof - The sleeping area of the orthopedic dog bed is made of 3-layer fabric. The Flannel surface is soft and skin-friendly. The middle TPU waterproof layer prevents liquid from penetrating, so the foam won't get wet. The inner knit fabric lining is durable enough for long time use. The bolsters are also wrapped in cuddly soft Flannel for enhanced comfort.

Removable Cover & Durable Zipper - The outer cover of the pet bed is equipped with premium L-shaped zipper, which is smooth and durable, makes it very easy to install the orthopedic egg crate foam. The cover is machine washable for easy care. The upgraded fabric and reinforced stitches ensure the cover remains as good as new after multiple washes.

Non-skid & Anti-scratch Bottom - The waterproof dog bed is built with water-resistant Oxford fabric on the bottom and sides, which is durable enough to hold up to daily wear and tear. The plastic dots on the bottom help prevent the dog bed from moving when our pet steps on or off, offering our little friend a strong sense of security.

Sizes & Customer Service - This washable dog bed measures 36"L x 27"W x 3"H, suitable for dogs up to 55 lbs. Since the dog bed is vacuum-packed for transportation, it usually takes 24-48 hours for the foam to rebound to original thickness. If you have any question about our product, please don’t hesitate to contact us, we are more than glad to help.

summary.text: Customers find this dog bed to be of good quality, comfortable, and spacious enough for extra large dogs. The bed features a well-padded cushion and is easy to wash, with one customer noting it can be removed for hand washing. They appreciate its durability, noting it holds up well in the washer, and consider it worth the price. Customers like how it fits, mentioning it's perfect for German shepherds and fits comfortably in medium-sized crates.
